neighbours.label: the word that completes a hedged claim of partial degree or influence in expository prose (played a role, only a proportion, isn't perfect, run into the billions, also affect, factors involved, will inevitably change); the negative pole is the other side of the distinction, sameness (same, equally, identical, unchanged)
fire: Most economists agree that housing costs played a role in the slowdown.
Even its supporters admit the new curriculum is far from perfect.
In practice only a proportion of the donated food ever reaches the shelters.
Repairs to the old stadium are expected to run into the billions.
Sleep quality can also affect how well students remember what they read.
Caffeine has a mild effect on blood pressure in most adults.
A mix of genetic and environmental factors seems to be involved.
Whatever the committee decides, the schedule will inevitably change.
quiet: Most economists agree that housing costs stayed the same during the slowdown.
Its supporters say the new curriculum was approved in March.
In practice all of the donated food is delivered to the shelters on Fridays.
Repairs to the old stadium were finished in the spring.
Students read the same chapter before the exam.
Caffeine is found in coffee, tea and chocolate.
The two samples were identical in colour and weight.
Whatever the committee decides, the schedule will be posted online.

predictions: fire items 0.2-0.45 on the completing word (role, perfect, fraction, millions, affect, effect, factors, change); near misses about the same topics without a degree claim below 0.05
notes: Card: no single token ('.' x4, ',' x2, then perfect, role, proportion, affect, billions, change, tiempo, effect, factors); max 13.1, density 0.45%; the - pole peaks on same/equally/identical/unchanged. Probe: 'only a fraction' 0.380, 'is perfect' (negated) 0.372, 'run into the millions' 0.317, 'plays a role' 0.294, 'also affect' 0.178, 'may contribute' 0.040; 'exactly the same treatment' 0.022, 'identical' 0.021, neutral 0.017. The + pole marks 'this matters to some degree' claims, the - pole 'no difference' claims.
